post.summary: Insert an element into a stored layout
post.description: Applies a single structural edit to the stored layout named by `{layoutId}` and commits it, returning the re-resolved tree plus diagnostics. Inserts a new element of the given `type` at the root, or into `parentElementId`/`slot` at the optional `index`. When the optional `bindingSpecificationId` is given, the named binding specification's wiring is applied onto the fresh element atomically after scaffold, in the same committed edit; an unregistered id is rejected with `400` (`bindingSpecificationNotFound`) and a specification whose declared `type` does not match the inserted `type` with `400` (`bindingTypeMismatch`) — the mutation throws before the repository write, so nothing is persisted on either failure. The committing write runs the resolvability gates, so a binding-breaking edit is rejected and nothing is written. `expectedVersion` is the optimistic-concurrency token; a malformed `expectedVersion` returns `400 invalidVersionToken`. Unknown request fields are rejected with `400` (`unknownRequestField`). Requires the `content_layout:update` privilege. Response diagnostics are derived from the layout's real source bindings, not a request hint.

409.description: Conflict, and nothing was written. Either the optimistic-concurrency token (`expectedVersion`) no longer matches the stored layout's current version (`CONTENT_SYSTEM__LAYOUT_VERSION_CONFLICT` — reload the layout, take the `updatedAt` the read returned, and retry), or the inserted type's default binding specification set holds more than one specification so no single default can be fill-applied (`CONTENT_SYSTEM__BINDING_SPECIFICATION_DEFAULT_AMBIGUOUS` — reachable only when a database row created outside the app lifecycle fakes a second default for the type; the mutation throws before the repository write instead of picking one).

post.summary: Replace an element's type in a stored layout
post.description: Applies a single structural edit to the stored layout named by `{layoutId}` and commits it, returning the re-resolved tree plus diagnostics. Replaces the type of `elementId` with `newType`. Anything the new type cannot keep is committed-out and reported, never silently lost: detached children in `orphaned` (re-place them with `attach-element`), wiring keys in `droppedWiring`, and static property values in `droppedProperties`. The committing write runs the resolvability gates. `expectedVersion` is the optimistic-concurrency token; a malformed `expectedVersion` returns `400 invalidVersionToken`. Unknown request fields are rejected with `400` (`unknownRequestField`). Requires the `content_layout:update` privilege.

Unknown request fields are rejected with `400` (`unknownRequestField`). Requires the `content_layout:update` privilege.

post.summary: Attach an element subtree into a stored layout
post.description: Applies a single structural edit to the stored layout named by `{layoutId}` and commits it, returning the re-resolved tree plus diagnostics. Splices the supplied `element` subtree into the root, or into `parentElementId`/`slot` at the optional `index`. Every id in the subtree is re-minted server-side; the placed ids are returned in `affectedElementIds`. Use this to re-place an `orphaned` subtree from an earlier edit. The committing write runs the resolvability gates. `expectedVersion` is the optimistic-concurrency token; a malformed `expectedVersion` returns `400 invalidVersionToken`. Unknown request fields are rejected with `400` (`unknownRequestField`). Requires the `content_layout:update` privilege.

post.summary: Bind a specification to an element in a stored layout
post.description: Applies a single structural edit to the stored layout named by `{layoutId}` and commits it, returning the re-resolved tree plus diagnostics. Binds `bindingSpecificationId`'s wiring onto `elementId`, mirroring the draft bind-element action. The committing write runs the resolvability gates. An unregistered `bindingSpecificationId` is rejected with `400` (`bindingSpecificationNotFound`); a specification whose declared `type` does not match the target element's `component` is rejected with `400` (`bindingTypeMismatch`). `expectedVersion` is the optimistic-concurrency token; a malformed `expectedVersion` returns `400 invalidVersionToken`. Unknown request fields are rejected with `400` (`unknownRequestField`). Requires the `content_layout:update` privilege.
